root_cause.text: The vulnerability is caused by a NULL pointer dereference in the `mt7925_mac_write_txwi` function where `ieee80211_vif_is_mld(vif)` is invoked without verifying that the `vif` pointer is non-NULL.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the modification of the conditional statement in `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mac.c` to prepend `vif &&` before calling `ieee80211_vif_is_mld(vif)`, ensuring the function is only executed when `vif` is valid.
